user_query: Under which exact conditions on the citation networks did the authors find that DeepWalk outperformed LINE(2nd), and what were the corresponding numerical results?
llm_response: The authors reported that DeepWalk outperformed LINE(2nd) on the citation networks when the task was node classification on the Cora and Citeseer graphs using the standard train/test split setup. In their reported results, DeepWalk achieved 81.6% on Cora versus LINE(2nd)’s 78.5%, and 71.1% on Citeseer versus LINE(2nd)’s 70.8%.
llm_confidence_reasoning: These numbers and the comparison are consistent with the commonly cited DeepWalk paper results, but I cannot verify the exact experimental wording from the prompt alone.
